title: Nurturing Irish Oats Bowl
description: A fermented, fluffy Irish oats dish with poached eggs, sautéed kale, and toasted almonds for a cozy, macrobiotic-friendly breakfast.
instructions: In a bowl, combine rolled oats, cold water, apple cider vinegar, and 1/4 tsp salt; cover and refrigerate overnight to ferment.
In the morning, stir the fermented oats, then pour into a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While oats heat, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high; add chopped kale, season with sea salt and pepper, sauté until wilted, about 3 minutes.
In a separate small pan, lightly poach the eggs in boiling water for 3 minutes, then transfer to a slotted spoon.
When oats reach a thick, creamy consistency, transfer to bowls.
Divide sautéed kale over the oats, top with poached eggs.
Sprinkle toasted almonds and fresh chives over the bowl.
Serve immediately for a warm, cozy Irish-style breakfast.
